featured.title: A Federal Judge Just Killed Trump's $100K H-1B Fee. Congress Wants to Bring It Back.
featured.excerpt: The ruling is a reprieve for Indian tech workers and their employers — but the PROTECT Act could codify the fee into law, and the DOJ is already appealing.

featured.nri_angle: Indian nationals account for roughly 72% of all H-1B visa approvals. The $100K fee had already frozen hiring pipelines across Silicon Valley; its removal reopens doors, but the legislative push to revive it means the threat hasn't passed.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The G7 Has Opened in Evian. Iran, Trade, and India's Seat at the Table Are All in Play.
news.excerpt: Modi arrives at the French lakeside summit with a dense agenda: the Iran peace deal, a Trump bilateral on Wednesday, and the visa question that won't go away.
news.image_caption: World leaders at a G7 summit group photo
news.nri_angle: The G7 agenda — Iran oil prices, US-India trade talks, and H-1B visa policy — directly shapes the economic and immigration landscape for millions of NRIs.

news.title: Indian Markets Surge as Iran Peace Deal Sends Oil Below $84 and Revives Inflow Hopes.

news.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai
news.nri_angle: RBI's new FCNR deposit window and a strengthening rupee make NRI remittances and property investments cheaper — if the oil price drop holds.

news.title: Gujarat Has Launched Its Industrial Policy 2026. It Wants Semiconductor Factories, Ultra Mega Projects, and NRI Capital.

news.nri_angle: Gujarat's semiconductor push, green manufacturing incentives, and GIFT City expansion create new investment channels for the state's 10-million-strong global diaspora.

news.nri_angle: NRI families with children or relatives preparing for medical entrance exams face uncertainty about the integrity of India's examination system.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's Factories Are Losing 40 Per Cent of Their Output to Heat. The Economic Cost Could Hit 4.5 Per Cent of GDP.
news.excerpt: In Kanpur, workers are collapsing or returning to their villages. New research shows the growth hit from rising temperatures is nearly double what economists previously believed.
news.nri_angle: NRIs with investments in Indian manufacturing and families back home face growing risks from a heat crisis that is cutting factory output and threatening the health of vulnerable relatives.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Washington Has Cut Off India From Anthropic's Best AI. Bengaluru Is Building Its Own.
news.excerpt: The US blocked Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all foreign nationals. India's Sarvam AI has raised $300 million and trained a 105-billion-parameter model for Indian languages. The sovereign AI race is on.
news.nri_angle: Indian technologists in the US face export controls based on nationality, while NRI investors see a new asset class emerging in India's sovereign AI ecosystem.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: A Republican Lawmaker Wants to Make the $100,000 H-1B Fee Permanent Law. Here Is What the PROTECT Act Would Do.
news.excerpt: Rep. Mike Kennedy filed the bill within 24 hours of a federal judge striking down Trump's executive fee. It would codify the tax at the congressional level — a route that is harder for courts to block.
news.image_caption: Rep. Mike Kennedy of Utah, sponsor of the PROTECT Act to codify the $100,000 H-1B visa fee
news.nri_angle: Three-quarters of H-1B holders are Indian — the PROTECT Act could permanently reshape the economics of working in America for hundreds of thousands of NRI professionals.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Rahul Gandhi Is Taking the Exam Scandal Fight to Kota. Here Is What Congress Is Demanding.
news.excerpt: A nationwide campaign against paper leaks and CBSE failures starts on June 17, with student conventions planned across four cities. The party wants NEET decentralised and the education minister gone.
news.image_caption: Rahul Gandhi, Leader of the Opposition, who will lead student conventions starting June 17 in Kota
news.nri_angle: Thousands of NRI and OCI students sit for CBSE board exams and NEET every year — a compromised examination system directly threatens the merit-based pathway that diaspora families count on.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The US-Iran Deal Is Done. Oil Has Dropped 4 Per Cent. Here Is What It Means for India.
news.excerpt: The Strait of Hormuz will reopen immediately. The naval blockade is over. A signing ceremony is set for Friday in Switzerland. And India's oil import bill just got significantly lighter.
news.image_caption: Map of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway between Iran and Oman that carries a fifth of the world's oil
news.nri_angle: Cheaper crude oil means a stronger rupee, lower petrol prices in India, and relief for NRIs watching the currency slide all year.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi Meets Trump Wednesday at G7. Trade, Visas, and Three Dead Sailors Are All on the Table.
news.excerpt: The bilateral comes as Washington threatens a 12.5 per cent tariff, H-1B approvals have dropped 40 per cent, and India has twice summoned the U.S. envoy over the killing of Indian sailors in the Gulf.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France
news.nri_angle: The meeting will determine whether the 12.5% tariff threat is walked back, whether H-1B processing gets relief, and whether Trump acknowledges the sailor deaths — all issues that directly affect NRIs.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Meta Will Build a 168-Megawatt AI Data Centre Inside Ambani's Jamnagar Complex. Here Is Why It Matters.

news.nri_angle: India's AI infrastructure is moving from government promises to concrete projects — creating high-skilled jobs, boosting Jio Platforms' IPO profile, and potentially reducing dependence on foreign AI providers.

news.title: America's Top Trade Negotiator Is Coming to India. A Deal Could Land by Mid-July.

news.nri_angle: A U.S.-India trade deal directly affects NRIs through tariff structures on remitted goods, pharmaceutical pricing, IT services market access, and the broader economic relationship that shapes visa and immigration policy.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi and Macron Have Drawn Up a Five-Year Plan to Double Trade. Here Is Everything They Agreed at Villa Kerylos.
news.excerpt: An Innovation Roadmap 2030, a joint AI working group, a new dialogue on critical minerals, and 19 signed agreements — the Nice summit delivered substance, not just ceremony.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi with French President Emmanuel Macron during a bilateral meeting
news.nri_angle: The bilateral outcomes directly affect NRIs through visa-free French airport transit, expanded education pathways, and a trade mechanism that could reshape India's commercial access to all 27 EU member states.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's Tech Leaders Are Demanding a $6 Billion AI Fund. The Anthropic Shutdown Made It Personal.

news.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers on H-1B visas at U.S. AI companies are now classified alongside all foreign nationals under the new export controls — making this both a policy story and a personal one for the diaspora workforce.

news.title: India Is Now Under Fire From Both Sides in the Gulf. The U.S. Struck Its Sailors. Trump Says Iran Attacked Its Ships Too.
news.excerpt: Three Indian seafarers are dead from a U.S. Navy strike. Hours later, Trump accused Iran of launching drones at Indian vessels. Jaishankar called Rubio to protest. India's 300,000 merchant sailors are caught in the middle of a war they played no part in starting.

news.nri_angle: India is the world's second-largest supplier of merchant seafarers — over 300,000 globally. Many NRI families in coastal states have relatives working on vessels in the Gulf, and the escalating attacks have triggered panic across the maritime community.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: A Judge Killed the $100,000 H-1B Fee. Four Days Later, He Froze His Own Ruling.

news.nri_angle: Indians account for over 70% of all H-1B petitions — the fee's fate directly determines whether hundreds of thousands of Indian professionals can afford to work in the United States.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Has Waived Customs Duty on Nuclear Equipment Going Back Seven Years. The Market Noticed.
news.excerpt: The retrospective exemption formalises an unwritten practice, cuts project costs, and sends nuclear stocks surging as India chases 100 GW by 2047.
news.image_caption: A nuclear power plant in India — the government has waived customs duty on equipment imports going back seven years
news.nri_angle: The nuclear duty waiver and 100 GW target create a multi-decade infrastructure investment opportunity for NRIs tracking India's energy transition.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Wants Diaspora Athletes to Play for the National Team. The 'Sports Passport' Is Now on Modi's Desk.
news.excerpt: The Sports Ministry has sent a proposal to the PM's Office and the Home Ministry that would let PIO and OCI athletes represent India without full citizenship — a move that could reshape the country's Olympic and FIFA ambitions.
news.image_caption: Indian football fans — the Blue Pilgrims — rallying in support of the national team at a 2018 match in Mumbai
news.nri_angle: Diaspora athletes of Indian origin — many trained in elite sporting systems in Europe, North America, and Australia — could finally represent India under this framework, connecting the global Indian community to the country's sporting future.

nri-world.title: Thirty-Two Words in Ninety Seconds: Shrey Parikh Wins the 2026 Scripps National Spelling Bee
nri-world.excerpt: The fourteen-year-old from Rancho Cucamonga shattered the spell-off record and extended Indian Americans' two-decade dominance of the country's premier academic competition.
nri-world.image_caption: A contestant at the Scripps National Spelling Bee competition in Washington, D.C.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian-American community has dominated the Spelling Bee for two decades; the victory reflects the diaspora's deep investment in academic competition and a self-reinforcing ecosystem of coaching, regional circuits, and family aspiration.

nri-world.title: India's Diaspora Dollars Hit $135 Billion — and They Are the Only Foreign Capital That Never Flinches
nri-world.excerpt: Record remittances in FY25 financed nearly half of India's trade deficit. With $140 billion projected for FY26, the NRI wire transfer has quietly become India's most reliable external lifeline.
nri-world.nri_angle: NRI remittances are the largest single source of hard currency flowing into India, outpacing FDI and FPI; the shift from Gulf blue-collar to US/UK white-collar sources reflects the diaspora's upward mobility; individual NRIs benefit from a weak rupee and competitive deposit rates.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Forty Thousand Restaurants and No Chain: India's Celebrity Chefs Are Finally Coming for the American Market
nri-world.excerpt: Sanjeev Kapoor in Santa Clara, Zorawar Kalra in Bellevue, Rishtedar in Miami — three branded Indian restaurant concepts have opened their first US outposts, betting that the country's $15 billion Indian food market is ready for its Chipotle moment.
nri-world.image_caption: An array of Indian dishes — the US Indian restaurant market is now valued at $15 billion
nri-world.nri_angle: The Indian restaurant market in the US has been built entirely by diaspora independents; the arrival of branded chains from India connects NRI diners to cultural touchstones from home while raising questions about mainstreaming vs. authenticity.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Three Dead, Three Ships Hit: Indian Sailors Are Caught in the Crossfire of America's Iran Blockade
nri-world.excerpt: In the deadliest week for Indian merchant seafarers in years, U.S. Navy strikes on three tankers off Oman killed three crew and forced scores to abandon ship — prompting India to summon the American diplomat twice and demand the attacks stop.
nri-world.image_caption: An oil tanker at sea — Indian-crewed vessels have been repeatedly struck by U.S. forces off the coast of Oman
nri-world.nri_angle: India has 300,000+ seafarers working globally, many from working-class families who depend on maritime income. The Gulf crisis threatens both lives and livelihoods across the diaspora.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Silicon Valley's Indian Americans Take Their Case to the FBI as Hindu Temple Attacks Spread Across the Bay Area
nri-world.excerpt: A group of prominent Indian Americans held an extraordinary meeting with federal officials and four police departments this week, demanding faster action on a wave of anti-Hindu vandalism and theft targeting Bay Area temples.
nri-world.image_caption: A Hindu temple in Sunnyvale, California — Bay Area temples have faced a wave of vandalism and hate-motivated attacks
nri-world.nri_angle: The Bay Area's Indian-American community — among the wealthiest and most professionally accomplished in the country — confronts the unsettling reality that its sacred spaces are being targeted, forcing community leaders into unfamiliar territory as security advocates.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Modi and Macron Open Bharat Innovates in Nice. The Real Story Is the 120 Startups Behind Them.

nri-world.nri_angle: The conclave gives NRI investors and entrepreneurs in Europe a structured way to connect with Indian innovation, while showcasing India's deep-tech ecosystem to global capital for the first time at this scale.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: A Margin of Seventy People: India Just Overtook England as Australia's Largest Source of Overseas-Born Residents
nri-world.excerpt: For the first time since records began in 1891, a non-British-origin group tops Australia's migration charts. The Indian-born population grew by 522,000 in a decade.
nri-world.image_caption: The Sydney Opera House and harbour — home to one of Australia's largest Indian-born communities
nri-world.nri_angle: Nearly a million Indians now call Australia home, making it the fourth-largest Indian diaspora community in the world. The milestone reshapes the conversation about belonging and identity for Indian Australians.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: King Charles Marks the British Asian Trust's 20th Year With a £1 Million Gala. The Timing Is Not Coincidental.
nri-world.excerpt: The monarch's charity has supported 18.8 million people across South Asia. At a London gala held against the backdrop of anti-Asian unrest, his presence sent a pointed message about community and belonging.
nri-world.image_caption: King Charles III, Royal Founding Patron of the British Asian Trust
nri-world.nri_angle: The King's charity, built around British Asian identity, has supported 18.8 million people in South Asia — and his visible patronage during anti-Asian unrest sends a signal to the 1.9 million Indians in the UK.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India Just Opened Its Stock Markets to Every Foreigner on the Planet. NRIs Are No Longer Special.
nri-world.excerpt: A quiet FEMA amendment published on June 12 replaces the phrase 'NRI or OCI' with 'any individual residing outside India,' dismantling a decades-old investment privilege the diaspora once had to itself.
nri-world.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai's Dalal Street financial district
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs and OCIs who long enjoyed exclusive retail access to Indian equities now share that privilege with every foreign individual — a levelling that could reshape how diaspora investors think about their edge in India's capital markets.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: From the Lincoln Memorial to Times Square: How Yoga Day 2026 Became the Diaspora's Biggest Public Ritual
nri-world.excerpt: The Indian Embassy will host its flagship Yoga Day celebration at the Lincoln Memorial on June 19, while Padma Shri HR Nagendra — Modi's personal yoga guru — headlines the Times Square event on June 21.
nri-world.image_caption: A group practising yoga outdoors in a park setting
nri-world.nri_angle: International Day of Yoga has evolved from a UN calendar date into the Indian diaspora's most visible annual public gathering in the West — a rare moment when thousands of Indian Americans occupy iconic American landmarks to practise something unmistakably Indian.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Dame Parveen Kumar Gets the GBE. She Is Now One of Britain's Most Decorated Indian-Born Citizens.
nri-world.excerpt: The 2026 King's Birthday Honours list, published on June 12, names at least eight British Indians — but the headline belongs to a gastroenterologist from Lahore who spent 40 years in the NHS.
nri-world.image_caption: Dame Parveen Kumar, elevated to GBE in the 2026 Birthday Honours
nri-world.nri_angle: The Birthday Honours remain the most visible annual scoreboard for British Indian professional achievement — and the 2026 list, with a GBE at the top, signals that the community's influence now reaches the highest tiers of the British establishment.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: GIFT City Is No Longer a Policy Experiment. NRI Wealth Managers Are Starting to Notice.
nri-world.excerpt: India's first international financial services centre has approved its inaugural family investment fund, drawn endorsements from Singapore's diplomats, and begun attracting Gulf-based NRI capital fleeing regional instability.
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs managing wealth across multiple jurisdictions now have a credible India-linked alternative to Dubai and Singapore — one that offers tax advantages, lower costs, and direct access to Indian markets without the regulatory friction of onshore investing.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India's Inflation Just Hit a New-Series High. For NRIs, the Real Number Is Much Worse.
markets-finance.excerpt: Official CPI rose to 3.93% in May, but food inflation is at 4.78%, fuel prices have been hiked four times, and the RBI just raised its full-year forecast to 5.1%. Every rupee you send home now buys less than it did in January.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI remittances are worth less in real terms as India's food and fuel inflation accelerates — the RBI's revised 5.1% forecast for FY27 means the purchasing power of every dollar sent home is eroding faster than at any point since the new CPI series launched.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.excerpt: The 15 per cent import duty was meant to defend the rupee. Instead it has fuelled a grey-market revival that could hit 100 tons this year — while JP Morgan forecasts $6,000 gold by December.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs buying gold for weddings or investment now face an 18.45 per cent embedded tax in India — reshaping how and where the diaspora acquires gold.

markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI investors face a double bind: the record foreign exit from Indian equities has eroded returns in dollar terms, but the structural shift toward domestic ownership may reduce future volatility and create a more favourable entry point.

markets-finance.title: India’s IT Stocks Have Lost 27 Per Cent This Year. For NRI Tech Workers, the Pain Is Doubly Personal.

markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI tech workers often hold ESOPs in Indian IT firms, invest in IT-heavy mutual funds, and work in the very sector AI threatens to disrupt — creating a rare triple concentration of career, portfolio, and identity risk.

markets-finance.title: GIFT City Just Got Its First US Company Listing. Here Is What NRIs Need to Know.

markets-finance.nri_angle: GIFT City is positioning itself as a tax-efficient hub specifically for NRI wealth management, cross-border investing, and India-linked portfolios — a direct alternative to routing capital through Dubai or Singapore.

markets-finance.title: India Just Opened Its Stock Market to Every Foreigner on Earth. Here Is What Changed Overnight.
markets-finance.excerpt: A sweeping FEMA amendment notified on June 12 replaces the NRI-only investment framework with one that lets any individual residing outside India buy and sell listed Indian equities — a historic shift in capital account liberalisation.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs already invested in Indian equities now share the playing field with every foreign individual globally — understanding the new rules, limits, and safeguards is essential to protect existing holdings.

markets-finance.title: Indian Banks Are Offering NRIs Up to 7% on Dollar Deposits. Here Is How to Get the Best Rate Before September.

markets-finance.title: India Just Threw Open Its Bond Market to the World. For NRI Investors, the Timing Could Not Be Better.

carousel.excerpt: Modi arrives at the French lakeside summit with a dense agenda: the Iran peace deal, a Trump bilateral on Wednesday, and the visa question that won't go away.
carousel.image_caption: World leaders at a G7 summit group photo
carousel.nri_angle: The G7 agenda — Iran oil prices, US-India trade talks, and H-1B visa policy — directly shapes the economic and immigration landscape for millions of NRIs.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Katrina Kaif Is Coming Back. And She Chose the Darkest Script in Town.
carousel.excerpt: Eighteen months after becoming a mother, the actress is reportedly in talks for Chandni Bar 2 — alongside Tabu, who defined the original. If this casting holds, it's the boldest return Bollywood has seen in years.

carousel.title: She Was Dropped Twice. Smriti Mandhana Made Pakistan Pay With 68 Off 44 at Edgbaston.
carousel.excerpt: Mandhana's fifth fifty in T20 World Cups ties Mithali Raj and Harmanpreet Kaur as India crush Pakistan by 64 runs to open their campaign
carousel.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana in India colours during an international match
carousel.nri_angle: Mandhana plays county cricket in England and is the most globally visible Indian woman cricketer — NRIs in the UK can watch her in person at this England-hosted World Cup.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: A Federal Judge Just Killed Trump's $100K H-1B Fee. Congress Wants to Bring It Back.
carousel.excerpt: The ruling is a reprieve for Indian tech workers and their employers — but the PROTECT Act could codify the fee into law, and the DOJ is already appealing.
carousel.image_caption: H-1B visa admissions by country of birth — India dominates with over 70% of all approvals
carousel.nri_angle: Indian nationals account for roughly 72% of all H-1B visa approvals. The $100K fee had already frozen hiring pipelines across Silicon Valley; its removal reopens doors, but the legislative push to revive it means the threat hasn't passed.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India's Inflation Just Hit a New-Series High. For NRIs, the Real Number Is Much Worse.
carousel.excerpt: Official CPI rose to 3.93% in May, but food inflation is at 4.78%, fuel prices have been hiked four times, and the RBI just raised its full-year forecast to 5.1%. Every rupee you send home now buys less than it did in January.
carousel.nri_angle: NRI remittances are worth less in real terms as India's food and fuel inflation accelerates — the RBI's revised 5.1% forecast for FY27 means the purchasing power of every dollar sent home is eroding faster than at any point since the new CPI series launched.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
